news.title: Odisha RERA grants four-month relief to housing projects hit by West Asia conflict
news.para: Odisha Real Estate Regulatory Authority has announced a four-month extension for project timelines affected by the West Asia conflict. This decision follows an advisory from the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs regarding project completion dates. Promoters are not required to pay any fees to obtain this extension. Registered projects with completion dates on or after February 28, 2026, qualify for this relief.

news.title: Spain approves housing measures after huge protests
news.para: In response to widespread public unrest and a significant general strike, Spain's interim lower house of parliament has officially approved housing reforms aimed at limiting evictions and controlling real estate speculation. These measures are set against the backdrop of upcoming national elections on November 29, where the opposition, led by the Popular Party, has signalled intentions to repeal such reforms if they come to power.

news.title: Unitech's net loss widens to ₹808 crore in Q2 FY27
news.para: Unitech Ltd has reported a consolidated net loss of Rs 808.45 crore for the quarter ending September, alongside a total income drop to Rs 120.94 crore compared to last year. Facing severe cash flow issues, the company has seen project delays, especially in Delhi-NCR, affecting 20,000 customers eager for their homes. Financial troubles have prompted government intervention and a complete board restructuring.

news.title: KW Group buys 1.5-acre land in Ghaziabad for ₹134 crore
news.para: KW Group has acquired the freehold parcel in Indirapuram through a Ghaziabad Development Authority auction. The proposed project will have a development potential of about five lakh sq ft and is backed by a ₹150 crore commitment from ASK Property Fund.

news.title: Somany Ceramics plans 16 million sq metre glazed vitrified tiles capacity addition
news.para: Somany Ceramics is set to expand its capacity for glazed vitrified tiles significantly within the next 18 months. By enhancing its joint venture in South India, the company expects to double output at this facility. Plans also include increasing production by adding four million square meters through debottlenecking existing plants.

news.title: FIRs issued against two Greater Bengaluru authority officials for issuing illegal e-khatas
news.para: Two assistant commissioners from the Greater Bengaluru Authority were suspended for issuing fraudulent e-khatas. They allegedly colluded with builders to misuse the e-Aasthi system's SARFAESI module. Officials approved applications using unrelated documents instead of mandatory SARFAESI orders. As a result, investigations were initiated for serious misconduct and abuse of official position. The case highlights significant violations under the Greater Bengaluru Governance Act.

news.title: Three Udyog Vihar construction sites among five sealed over dust violations in Gurugram
news.para: Five construction sites in Gurgaon were sealed for failing to comply with dust-control regulations during an inspection. The Haryana State Pollution Control Board conducted enforcement actions against sites for violations of air quality management directions. Construction sites are required to adhere to prescribed dust-mitigation measures to prevent dust emissions. Inspections will continue across the region as authorities seek to improve compliance.

news.title: Prayagraj Metro DPR sent for approval, two corridors proposed at ₹15,758 crore
news.para: The Prayagraj Development Authority has put forward the Detailed Project Report for a transformative Metro rail initiative. This project includes two routes covering around 44 km to improve connectivity within Prayagraj. One route will directly connect Prayagraj Airport to City Lake Forest, while the second will link Shantipuram to Chheoki.

news.title: Land losers in Bengaluru’s Karanth Layout seek alternative plots without additional charges
news.para: Affected property owners from Dr Shivaram Karanth Layout are requesting the BDA for alternative locations without incurring added costs or new requirements. They highlight that almost 12 years have elapsed since the expropriation of their lands, hinting at insufficient coordination from the BDA. In light of this, the aggrieved landowners are calling for a meeting with BDA to discuss their concerns and find a resolution.

news.title: Tripura government to auction 10 NBFC properties worth ₹63.65 crore
news.para: The Tripura government is gearing up for an auction of ten properties linked to non-banking financial firms on November 17, boasting an estimated worth of ₹63.65 crore across six subdivisions. Interested bidders can explore the properties until November 16. Key highlights include holdings from Basil International Ltd and the Rose Valley Group of Companies, facilitated by MSTC Ltd under the guidance of the Directorate of Institutional Finance.

news.title: Tamil Nadu rolls out online facility to draft, register property documents in four steps
news.para: Property buyers and sellers in Tamil Nadu can now prepare their own registration documents online. The Registration Department has launched a self-service facility under its upgraded STAR 3.0 system. Users can access various document templates, enter necessary details, and pay charges online. The system allows linking details from previously registered documents to minimize data entry.

news.title: Sealing to restart against PGs, hotels set up at housing units in Gurugram
news.para: The Department of Town and Country Planning is set to renew its efforts to seal unauthorized commercial properties in Gurgaon. Inspections will concentrate on key licensed areas like DLF and Sushant Lok, targeting those with unauthorized residential conversions and stilt parking. This initiative aligns with Supreme Court directives for consistent enforcement, highlighting the urgency for compliance ahead of the November 23 report submission.

news.title: Gurugram: Residents of Vatika Xpressions protest after boundary wall demolished
news.para: Residents of Vatika Xpressions in Sector 88B rallied together to protest the demolition of a boundary wall by 4S Developers. Armed individuals and heavy machinery were spotted, prompting demands for police action and heightened community security. While a company representative claimed legal compliance in accessing land, the residents are calling for an in-depth investigation and open dialogue to resolve the issue amicably.

news.title: Property investor exodus drives record quarterly fall in Australian home lending
news.para: New home loans in Australia experienced a record decline in the September quarter, dropping by 15.5 percent. Investor lending fell sharply as borrowing costs increased following interest rate hikes by the central bank. The Australian government announced impending tax policy changes that will impact property investment. Both owner-occupier and investment property loans reported significant decreases in value during this period.

news.title: Developers turn selective on land acquisitions; JDAs gain share in 9M 2026: Anarock
news.para: Developers closed 76 land transactions spanning about 1,445 acres during the first nine months of 2026, compared with 99 deals covering nearly 3,292 acres in the corresponding period last year. Joint development agreements accounted for 25% of transactions during the period.

news.title: Cabinet approves ₹2,390 crore metro rail link from Noida sector 51 to Greater Noida sector 4
news.para: The Union Cabinet has approved a project that will expand the Aqua Line Metro Rail Corridor, linking Noida Sector 51 to Greater Noida Sector 4 across 8.449 kilometres. This extension, equipped with five elevated stations, is expected to boost public transit, cut down on travel time, and relieve congestion, paving the way for improved urban mobility and economic advancement in the area.

news.title: NBCC India expects ₹50,000-60,000 crore order inflow in FY27; plans to monetise 54-acre land bank
news.para: The company expects its consolidated order book to reach about ₹1.80-2 lakh crore by the end of FY27. It is also looking at projects worth around ₹10,000 crore each in West Bengal and Bihar, while ₹9,600 crore of Supertech works are targeted for award during Q3 FY27.

news.title: Eldeco Housing eyes ₹5,500 crore from project pipeline; targets three launches by March 2027
news.para: The company's ongoing projects could generate ₹1,600-1,700 crore, while forthcoming projects have an estimated revenue potential of ₹3,000-3,200 crore. Eldeco Housing is targeting launches of Shaheed Path, Palm Springs and Eldeco Namah before March 2027.

news.title: Indore civic body razes structures under construction to develop illegal colony
news.para: Acting on information received by the Indore civic body, its removal team reached the site and razed the structures. Drainage lines were being laid and columns had been erected at the spot. The action was carried out on the directions of Commissioner Kshitij Singhal.

news.title: DTCP issues notices to three PGs set up in illegal Manesar colony
news.para: The town and country planning department's enforcement wing has sent out notices to three property owners for allegedly running paying guest accommodations in a non-permitted area in Manesar. After a chief minister's flying squad inspection revealed rule breaches under the Haryana Development and Regulation of Urban Areas Act, the department has mandated that landowners halt construction and provide required documents. Failure to comply may result in legal consequences.
